name: import_audio_clip_gui
verified_note: Confirmed on FL 26.1.7 on 2026-10-20 with two full runs (plus two more after the menu entry switched to template matching) in a row (12 steps, channel added, waveform shown, window closed). Anchors add_menu and audio_clip_menu_item sit in FL's fixed top menu; the file button and the close button are found from the Audio Clip window's own position because plugin windows open where they were last left. Pixel values are for a 2560x1440 screen. A leftover Audio Clip window from an earlier failed run makes the window lookup ambiguous: close it first. The Audio Clip menu entry is found by its picture (template audio_clip_menu_item) because the ADD menu differs between projects; a fixed position hit another entry once.
summary: Load an audio file into a new Audio Clip channel using the top ADD menu and the open dialog.
source: measured on this install; menu names from the Channel rack add (+) menu
